title: Indus floods, Pakistan (2022)
summary: Radar sees the flood under monsoon clouds.

explanation.driver: Extreme monsoon rainfall in July–August 2022 flooded the lower Indus plain.
explanation.polarizationNote: VV backscatter drops sharply over calm open water (specular reflection), so flooded fields turn dark.
explanation.howToRead: Blue = backscatter decreased after the event → likely new standing water. Red = increase.
explanation.caveats: Wind-roughened water and radar shadow can mimic or hide change.

credits: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2022, processed by ASF HyP3
